metadata.description: Red tiles form a fish in profile with fins, scales and a split tail. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Floating terraces surround the motif, with staggered terraces along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
